To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Bax limits adult neural progenitor cell survival through activation of caspases and the IP3 receptor.
Bax limits neural stem cell persistence by modulating IP3R-dependent calcium flux.
Bax limits adult neural progenitor cell survival by modulating calcium flux through the IP3 receptor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of Bax in the control of adult neural stem cell number through the modulation of calcium signaling.
the regulation of neural stem cell fate and function.
the molecular mechanisms controlling neural stem cell fate in the adult mammalian brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Bax is required for adult neural stem cell apoptosis and that Bax-mediated adult NSC death is regulated by the IP3 receptor and caspase activity.
Bax and casapase-3 are important in the control of neural stem cell survival and function in the adult mammalian brain.
Bax limits the persistence of multipotent adult neural stem cells through activation of the caspase and calcium-dependent apoptotic machinery.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
adult neural stem cells use the proapoptogenic protein Bax to limit their own survival by modulating calcium flux through the inositol triphosphate (IP3) receptor.
adult neural stem cell apoptosis is controlled by the Bax protein through activation of the intrinsic apoptotic pathway, which is mediated by the IP3 receptor.
the proapoptosis molecule Bax is involved in limiting the numbers of adult neural stem cells in the brain through the activation of caspases and the IP3 receptor in a calcium-dependent manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Bcl-2 family of proteins is not only critical to the survival of embryonic neural stem cells, but also adult neural stem cells.
the Bax-mediated death of adult neural stem cells is not due to the activation of the intrinsic pathway of cell death.
Bax is not required for adult neural stem cell differentiation or proliferation.
